recommendation.title: Sync: say when a retry is happening
recommendation.why: Smallest open thing with a finished review: one commit, two parts, no overlap with anything else in flight. Merging it clears the oldest open item.
recommendation.links: Touches the same sync parts as the sync safety audit (idle since 11 Sep); nothing active collides.
recommendation.seams: The retry message comes from the sync engine and is shown by the sync screen. Make the wording a setting of the engine, not the screen, so the phone shows the same words.
